title: Climate zones of Africa
intro: Name the Koppen-Geiger climate class of each city in Africa. The class is read from a 1 km map for the city's location.

questions.prompt: Which Koppen-Geiger climate class does Douala, Cameroon have?
choices: Cfa: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer
questions.explain: On the Beck et al. 1980-2016 map, Douala lies in class Am: Tropical, monsoon.

questions.prompt: Which Koppen-Geiger climate class does Durban, South Africa have?
choices: Cfa: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer
Cfb: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer
Cwa: Temperate, dry winter, hot summer
questions.explain: On the Beck et al. 1980-2016 map, Durban lies in class Cfa: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer.
